verdict.rationale: Cross-device task continuity is a fair question for a desktop operating system, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a handoff, continuity, or paired-device resume feature. Snap groups (windows-docs-6) let you return to window arrangements on the same machine, and the tablet-to-laptop claim (windows-docs-19) is about switching a 2-in-1's form factor; neither is device-to-device continuation.
